title: 递增顺序搜索树
summary: 重排二叉搜索树，使最左节点成为根，每个节点没有左孩子且只有递增的右孩子。
insight: BST 中序遍历得到递增节点序列；用虚拟头和 tail 指针边遍历边断开左孩子并串到右链。
pitfalls: 必须清空每个节点左指针

solutions.title: 中序重连右链
solutions.idea: 遍历节点时把它接到尾部并推进尾指针。

code.java: class Solution { private TreeNode tail;public TreeNode increasingBST(TreeNode root){TreeNode dummy=new TreeNode(0);tail=dummy;inorder(root);return dummy.right;}private void inorder(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);node.left=null;tail.right=node;tail=node;inorder(node.right);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var tail:TreeNode;fun increasingBST(root:TreeNode?):TreeNode?{val dummy=TreeNode(0);tail=dummy;inorder(root);return dummy.right};private fun inorder(node:TreeNode?){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);node.left=null;tail.right=node;tail=node;inorder(node.right)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { TreeNode* tail;void inorder(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return;inorder(node->left);node->left=nullptr;tail->right=node;tail=node;inorder(node->right);}public:TreeNode* increasingBST(TreeNode* root){TreeNode dummy(0);tail=&dummy;inorder(root);return dummy.right;} };
